name: mock-ssc-portal
description: Standalone mock government examination portal (GovRecruit-A / SSC_EXAM_PORTAL). A genuinely separate website from OTR-India — it never shares a codebase, origin, or session with the OTR frontend. It authenticates citizens by redirecting to OTR's /authorize screen and retrieves only the data the citizen consented to, via OTR's public token-based API.
